ato.report.summary:description: Open the foldout below for per-atlas details.
ato.report.summary:hint: See the console for the full [ATO] log.
ato.report.cancelled: Avatar Texture Optimizer: build cancelled by user
ato.error.no_descriptor: ATO component found, but this avatar root has no VRCAvatarDescriptor. Add the component to the avatar root object.
ato.error.not_on_root: The ATO component must be placed on the avatar root (the object with VRCAvatarDescriptor).
ato.warn.extra_component_removed: A duplicate ATO component was found and removed. Only one component per avatar is allowed.
ato.warn.format_platform_clamped: The selected compression format is not available on the target platform; clamped to a safe default.
ato.warn.format_alpha_clamped: The texture contains alpha; the selected no-alpha format was replaced with an alpha-capable format.
ato.warn.format_gray_clamped: The grayscale texture uses multiple channels; the single-channel format was replaced with a multi-channel format.
ato.ui.generateAtlas.tip: When unchecked, textures are only scaled as a whole and import parameters optimized (no atlasing, no UV changes).
ato.ui.preset.nearlossless.tip: Near-lossless mode keeps original resolutions and copies islands 1:1 (quality = 1).
ato.ui.whitelist.tip: Any object type is allowed (mesh, material, texture, animation, GameObject...). All textures referenced by whitelisted objects skip every optimization.
ato.ui.npot.tip: Uses 64px steps instead of powers of two. NPOT atlases have been verified to support Mip Streaming and Crunch; unsupported formats (e.g. PVRTC on iOS) are excluded automatically.
ato.ui.compression.tip: Formats are offered per category (alpha / opaque / normal / grayscale) and per platform. Build-time safety fallbacks always protect the avatar.
ato.ui.compression.autoNote: Auto picks BC7 (PC) / ASTC (mobile) defaults; set explicit formats in the platform override section below.
ato.ui.platform.tip: Like Unity's platform override: check a platform to override all optimization parameters for it. Default values follow the current build target.
